preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a valid tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of transformations k must be between 0 and 2n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= y_prime <= n for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: Each transformation must involve valid vertex indices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(k) + '\n' + '\n'.join(f'{x} {y} {y_prime}' for x, y, y_prime in transformations)
postconditions.description: The output must correctly format the number of transformations and each transformation.
